analysis.insight_summary: Users are trying to determine if it’s possible to upgrade [product_name] V8 directly to V8.1 [version_no], and whether this upgrade is free or requires payment. There is some confusion due to ambiguous documentation and links, leading to questions about version compatibility and cost. Peer support is quick, but official information lacks complete clarity.
